skill.name: set-up-shopware-meta-conversions-api
skill.description: Set up server-side purchase tracking from a Shopware 6 sales channel to Meta through Product Metrics. Check consent settings and verify event delivery with a test order.
skill.summary: Connect Shopware to the Meta Conversions API and verify purchase event delivery.
skill.author: product-metrics

security_audit.summary: Of 55 scanner flags, 53 are false positives for routine setup, documentation, or Markdown syntax. Two flags identify broad order retrieval and unpinned installer execution. The review also found unsafe credential handling and no explicit approval checkpoint for live delivery.

remediation.issue: The assistant can request a Meta access token.
remediation.suggestion: Remove the chat credential exception. Require users to enter tokens directly in the authenticated Product Metrics app or through a secure credential input.

remediation.issue: The setup can enable sending before the user reviews consent and payloads.
remediation.suggestion: Verify consent before enabling delivery. Test with synthetic orders, disclose Product Metrics and the matching fields, and require approval before switching to live sending.

remediation.issue: Order lookup defaults to recent orders and then requests a full record.
remediation.suggestion: Require a confirmed workspace, sales channel, and test order reference. Request only delivery status and suppress shopper identifiers in tool output.

remediation.issue: The install example does not pin the installer or the skill revision.
remediation.suggestion: Provide a vetted installer version and an immutable skill revision or checksum. Keep installation manual and require approval before running any external installer.

content.user_title: Set Up the Meta Conversions API for Shopware
content.value_statement: Browser-only tracking can miss Shopware purchases. Connect Shopware to Meta through Product Metrics and use a test order to verify server-side delivery.
actual_capabilities: Read Product Metrics setup status through its CLI or MCP connector.
Guide a Shopware administrator through plugin installation and pairing for one sales channel.
Guide a Meta administrator through connecting the intended pixel or dataset.
Identify the supported consent banner settings and explain which events require additional consent.
Guide test order verification and help diagnose missing or failed event delivery.
Explain how to create custom conversions for received revenue or profit events.
limitations: Requires Product Metrics Pro, Shopware 6.7, PHP 8.2 or later, and access to the intended Meta pixel or dataset.
Each plugin installation handles one sales channel. Shopware and Meta admin steps require a person.
Delivery depends on shopper consent. Profit events require complete contribution margin data.
Past orders are not imported. Later refunds and cancellations do not update events already sent to Meta.

use_cases.title: Plan a Store Integration
use_cases.description: Identify prerequisites, required account access, and the steps to connect a Shopware sales channel.

use_cases.title: Validate Purchase Delivery
use_cases.description: Check whether a test purchase appears in Meta and distinguish connection problems from consent or test mode settings.

use_cases.title: Diagnose a Pairing Delay
use_cases.description: Check channel settings, scheduled tasks, and message workers when the connection does not become active.

prompt_templates.title: List Setup Requirements
prompt_templates.prompt: What do I need to connect my Shopware 6 store to Meta through Product Metrics? Give me a checklist without changing any settings.

prompt_templates.title: Check Setup Progress
prompt_templates.prompt: Check setup status for [workspace] and [sales channel]. List completed steps and the next manual action. Do not change settings.

prompt_templates.title: Verify One Test Purchase
prompt_templates.prompt: Guide me through checking synthetic test order [reference] in Meta Test Events. Keep tokens out of chat and do not enable live sending.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: Validate delivery in test mode.

prompt_templates.title: Investigate Missing Conversions
prompt_templates.prompt: Review consent settings, delivery status, and browser pixel deduplication for [sales channel]. Use only [test order reference]. Keep the review read-only and exclude shopper details.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: Diagnose differences without accessing unrelated orders.

output_examples.input: The Shopware connection still shows Setup required. What should I check?
output: Confirm the selected sales channel uses the verified HTTPS storefront address.
Check that Shopware scheduled tasks and message workers are running.
After the next sync cycle, select Verify connection again.

output_examples.input: The test purchase arrived, but reports still show no new purchases.
output: An event in Test Events verifies the connection. It does not count in reports.
Check whether a test event code is still saved.
Review the destination and consent settings before clearing the code for live delivery.

output_examples.input: Meta received my test purchase but shows no profit event.
output: Check whether Product Metrics has complete contribution margin data for the test order.
Check that the test session granted the consent required for custom events.
Run another synthetic test before creating a profit conversion.

best_practices: Confirm the Product Metrics property, Shopware sales channel, and Meta dataset before making changes.
Enter pairing and Meta access tokens only in their designated admin interfaces.
Verify the actual consent banner and delivery with a synthetic test order before approving live events.
anti_patterns: Do not paste access tokens or shopper records into chat.
Do not use the most recent real order as a substitute for an identified test order.
Do not use server-side delivery to bypass a shopper's consent choices.

faq.question: Does it support Shopware 5?
faq.answer: No. The documented plugin requires Shopware 6.7 and PHP 8.2 or later.

faq.question: Do I need Product Metrics?
faq.answer: Yes. The workflow uses a Product Metrics Pro workspace and the Product Metrics Shopware plugin.

faq.question: Can one installation track all sales channels?
faq.answer: No. Each plugin installation tracks the Shopware sales channel you pair.

faq.question: Can I keep my browser Meta Pixel?
faq.answer: Yes. Meta deduplicates events with the same name and ID within 48 hours. The purchase event uses the order transaction ID.

faq.question: What customer data can reach Meta?
faq.answer: With consent, Meta can receive hashed email, name, postal code, and country, plus IP address and browser information. Browser IDs also require ad storage consent.

faq.question: Where should I enter my Meta access token?
faq.answer: Enter it directly in the authenticated Product Metrics Meta destination form. Do not share it in chat.
